doc: Bellows' 3D clip map (owner r3d-anim-bellows-a; index §7.10): the s2-view §4.1.1 schema over view/world/default_maps/bellows.json (every key left out falls back to it; this file wins key by key). Clip ids = the 2D ids; sidecars data/anim/bellows3d/<clip>.json. walk entries carry the 3D gait (stride_m, speed_m_s: the clip's sidecar values; RigPlayer3D scales playback to the actor's speed) and the 2D stride_px / speed_px_s the ClipMap uses to detect a walk and its nominal speed (1 m = 200 px). Rows of r3d-anim-bellows-b (state:spotted, activity:curious, oneshot:*, bit:*, mg:*) and -c (walk@tier3, activity:hunt, cue:laugh_*) are listed from their DONE lines (the same ids as the default map). The curtain-call clips (curtain:wander_on / slow_burn / bonk / double_take) are clip_rules.json rows with the same ids.
